metadataAttributes.title: PM-2026-058: NetworkPolicy blocked the billing worker from the ledger service
metadataAttributes.fix: Changed spec.ingress[0].from[0].podSelector.matchLabels.app of the server's NetworkPolicy from the old client label to the client's current label, via a GitOps pull request. Clue: client probe timeouts while the server's endpoints are all ready=true.
